title: Bethlehem
lead: A small town in the hills of Judah, about six miles south of Jerusalem. Its name means "house of bread." It was the home of Naomi, Boaz and David, the place of Micah's promised ruler, and the birthplace of Jesus.

sections.b: Rachel died and was buried "on the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem" (Genesis 35:19). In Judges, Bethlehem is the home of a Levite who served at an idol shrine (Judges 17:7–13) and of the woman abused at Gibeah (Judges 19). It is the home of Naomi and Boaz, and of David, whom Samuel anointed there (1 Samuel 16:1–13). Micah promised a ruler from "Bethlehem Ephrathah" (Micah 5:2), and Matthew and Luke place Jesus' birth there (Matthew 2:1–6; Luke 2:4–7), where Luke calls it "the city of David."
